audience: Software builders who want to turn an idea into useful, expressive behavior
brief: Create a product-specific MiniMax Code film for software builders. Show a cleared real MiniMax Agent interface session: a concrete request, the agent working, and the corresponding result. Choose the example from confirmed facts and authorized material; do not imply that unrelated sessions are one workflow.

facts.text: MiniMax describes Coding and Work modes for its coding harness.
The product page describes agents teaming up to tackle tasks.
The product description includes working with images, video and audio, and creating scripts and voiceovers.
In the documented MiniMax Code CLI example, the first request adds a Pomodoro timer to an existing browser pet.
The follow-up requests hold-to-pause behavior for that timer.
The same example adds a completion celebration, shown by the happy pet in the browser footage.
This is a CLI example using an existing starter and BYOK. The maintainer finished the visual design; the visibly labeled ten-second demo is not generation time.

notes: Owner rejected both screenshot slideshows and camera-only movement over the same stills: the film did not explain what the product does. Make the relation between a request, a concrete action/control and its resulting behavior legible. Pointer movement, clicking and holding are allowed and useful; motion needs a purpose, not merely pixel change. Show the product and brand early enough to read; normalize real-source framing before designing a continuity anchor, keep compounds readable, and clear outgoing content before unrelated CTA text enters. Tiny aligned coordinates and seek determinism do not establish visible continuity or motion quality. Retain the improved audible procedural funk at 100 BPM and deliberate visual/sound landings, but choose the shot structure and timing; no prescribed opener, three-shot order, ui-showcase/ui-journey selection or fixed beat schedule. Use the huashu-motion directing workflow as a method reference: read the product, choose distinct directions, write treatment and continuity, build the hardest shot first, then inspect actual frames and normal-speed motion. Use trusted blocks where they fit; original sandboxed custom scenes are now approved for choreography they cannot express. The cleared screenshots are evidence, not a requirement to display them as intact slides or to use every state. Do not use decorative focus ROI boxes. The owner rejected the real-operation edit because it shows the resulting timer but no actual MiniMax Agent interface operation. Source and clear a real Agent session showing a request, the agent working, and the corresponding result. Do not imply the approved CLI pocket-pet example was generated in an unrelated Agent GUI session, or substitute screenshot animation for the requested real interaction. The three ingested pet states remain stills. The current automatic material manifest still contains images only; the real-video manual cut is local. If using the documented CLI pocket-pet example, retain the readable credit "CLI example · Maintainer-finished visuals". A different real Agent session needs its own accurate provenance, not that CLI-specific credit. Do not claim the existing starter or visual design was generated from scratch, call the pet a MiniMax logo or physical device, or confuse the visible ten-second timer with generation time. No test-count, speed, cost or outcome guarantees. Use the authentic cleared MiniMax Code mark early and at the ending; preserve Explore MiniMax Code and agent.minimax.io exactly. Choose only the confirmed facts needed for the story; retain all source facts and license boundaries.
